gaps.quote: A label $U$ is a nondegenerate subspace of $\mathcal F$.
gaps.note: Nondegeneracy of a subspace relative to a bilinear form is not defined, and the page never says how the form I-J/9 on Q^h extends to the tensor cube F. The projection along U-perp used later needs this, and an undergraduate linear algebra course does not cover it.

gaps.quote: Each unit of rank costs one smaller call. (cited)
gaps.note: The edge matrices, how total rank over edges is defined, and why one unit of rank means one recursive call are not explained. This is the central link between the linear algebra and the recursion.

gaps.quote: Along a side wire, a label containing $t_T$ may grow to $t_S^\perp$, since $t_T\perp t_S$, adding $h-2$ dimensions.
gaps.note: Side wires are never defined. Labels are subspaces of F=(Q^h)^{\otimes 3} but t_T lives in Q^h, so containment is unclear. Why the label may grow, and what t_S^perp means in F, is not said.

gaps.quote: Signed label changes telescope along each wire, and gate labels cancel.
gaps.note: The page never says how each edge's matrix or signed change is defined or which labels the edges join, so the telescoping and cancellation cannot be checked.
The page does not say how many sinks there are (W of them), which sinks receive the sources, or why the signed total is sinks minus sources.

gaps.quote: Each of the $2\binom h3^2$ invocations has $h$ central wires, each losing $h$ on a decreasing edge, so $L=3\binom h3^2h^2$.
gaps.note: Invocations are never defined. The count as stated gives 2*binom^2*h*h, not 3*binom^2*h^2, so the factor 3 does not follow.
